Axiom: Language quality is a legitimate finding class — verb-calques (`AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE`), канцелярит / broken agreement (`AX_OPERATOR_DIALOGUE_STYLE`), a term drifting from its owning specification — but it is SECONDARY to `AX_PRODUCT_ARCHITECT_LENS`. A language finding rides along at `MINOR`, attached to the round; it never drives the verdict to NEEDS_WORK by itself. Escalate it past `MINOR` only when the wording actually distorts meaning — an ambiguous contract, a requirement two readers would resolve differently — then judge it by ordinary `AX_SEVERITY`, not as language hygiene.
